digest.component_or_area: plan-review criterion T1 (overlay-priorart), web-search capability gating
propositions: T1 (a blocking criterion) lost server-side web-search access after the Bedrock cutover because _anthropic_web_search_capabilities() gates on provider-name prefix 'anthropic', and the Bedrock model name 'bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8' does not match
The prefix-matching gate violates the epic's zero-exceptions rule that capability decisions must derive from registry membership, not provider-name shape
T1's verdict provenance does not record whether web access was attached, making the silent withdrawal undetectable in signed outputs

Web access must be guaranteed for T1 on every provider rebar routes it to, whether by native server-side tool (Anthropic) or rebar-side fallback (Bedrock via DuckDuckGo); the design decision to use provider-side-only web search must be revisited rather than worked around
T1's prompt must assert web access as a guarantee rather than hedging it as provider-dependent, while preserving the clause forbidding fabricated citations
